authority_chain.role: sealed Stage-A record identifying the exact panel manifest object
seal binding the Stage-A authority trace
identity source; only neighborhood_id is parsed

v03_retired_dependency: seal/seal-manifest.json and its unresolved v03 expected hash are excluded entirely
extraction_order: verify v04 Stage-A trace hash locally
open only firewall-lock.json; verify its exact SHA-256
parse only top-level /panel_manifest_sha256 and require the sealed value
open only the exact heldout-matched-panel-manifest.jsonl path
hash the complete manifest bytes and require the firewall-bound SHA-256
only after hash pass, parse top-level neighborhood_id from each JSONL row
require exactly 2000 valid unique canonical identities
hash canonical identity UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256; sort the unique hashes

identity_canonicalization.unicode_rule: must already be Unicode NFC; reject rather than normalize
identity_canonicalization.whitespace_rule: must be nonempty and have no leading or trailing whitespace; reject rather than trim
identity_canonicalization.hash_input: exact validated canonical string encoded as UTF-8

failure_policy.source_hash_or_binding_mismatch: persist failure access receipt with observed digest and stop
